pages.text: Geolosys took every vanilla vein, so ore is in deposits, not sprinkled through the stone. Caves are how you reach the deep ones, and the deep pays better:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Deep deposits$() under every biome: lead and silver, nickel, platinum, tin, gold. A deep cave finds them in its walls.$(li)$(bold)Deepslate metal ore$() gives one to two clusters a block.

$(li)$(bold)Mineshafts and dungeons:$() YUNG's, plus Repurposed Structures' biome versions (icy, desert, jungle, swamp...). Cataclysm's ruins and Ancient Factory.$(li)$(bold)Chests pay more the deeper they are:$() every underground chest carries ore; below Y 0 it adds the rare metals, below Y -32 diamonds and platinum.

$(li)$(bold)Cave goods sell:$() bounty boards ask for amethyst, glow lichen, dripstone, moss, spore blossoms, sculk and echo shards; the capital's later projects want glow berries, deepslate and amethyst.$(li)$(bold)The deep dark$() holds the Warden, one of the three holders of the Ender logistics Blueprint ($(l:patchouli:tech/tier4)Tier 4$()).

Rumour maps to the deeper bosses turn up in the same chests. A mineshaft is a good first expedition: wood, rails, chests, and the way to the deposits below.$(br2)Bring a bed, torches and a dog. Mobs are smarter here than you remember.
